declarations.value:
linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(3, 9, 17, 0.98), rgba(3, 9, 17, 0.75)),
    image-set(
        url('assets/images/optimized/site/switchgear-1280.avif') type('image/avif'),
        url('assets/images/optimized/site/switchgear-1280.webp') type('image/webp'),
        url('assets/images/site/switchgear.jpg') type('image/jpeg')
      )
      center/cover

transform 0.25s var(--ease),
    box-shadow 0.25s var(--ease),
    border-color 0.25s var(--ease),
    background 0.25s var(--ease)

border-color 0.22s var(--ease),
    background-color 0.22s var(--ease),
    color 0.22s var(--ease),
    box-shadow 0.22s var(--ease),
    transform 0.22s var(--ease)
